pages.accepted_text: DECLARATION OF ZONING LOT RESTRICTIONS The China Building LLC, a New York limited liability company, having its principal office at 79 Metropolitan Ave,Brooklyn, New York,NY 11249 and 66N3 Owner LLC,an New York limited liability company, having its office at c/o Flatiron Real Estate Advisors, LLC, 119 West 23rd Street, Suite 903, New York, New York 10011, constituting the “parties in interest" (except for those parties waiving their respective rights to join herein) as defined in Section 12- 10(d) of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York,effective December 15,1961,as amended from time to time ("Zoning Resolution"), with respect to Tax Lots 12 & 22' in Block 2357 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings (collectively, the “Properties"), as more particularly described in Exhibit A attached hereto,do hereby declare that the Properties are to be treated as one zoning lot for the purpose of and in accordance with the provisions of the Zoning Resolution. The Properties are known as and by street addresses: (i) 62 North 3rd Street, Brooklyn, New York (Block 2357, Lot 12); and (i) 87 Metropolitan Avenue, Brooklyn, New York (Block 2357, Lot 22). 1. Reference is hereby made to that certain Zoning Lot Development Agreement dated the date hereof and intended to be recorded in the Office of the City Register, Kings County, which sets forth certain rights and obligations of the parties with respect to the land affected hereby. 2. No breach by any party to this Declaration, or any agreement ancillary hereto, shall have any effect on the treatment of the Properties as a single zoning lot for purposes of the Zoning Resolution and the Properties shall be treated as one zoning lot unless such Combined Zoning Lot is subdivided in accordance with the provisions of the Zoning Resolution. 3. This Declaration constitutes a covenant running with the land and shall bind and inure to the benefit of the Declarants, their respective successors and assigns and every party now or hereafter acquiring any right, title or interest therein or in any part thereof. 4. This Declaration shall be recorded in the Conveyances Section of the Office of the City Register for Kings County in accordance with the provisions of Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. 5.This Declaration may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be an original and all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same instrument. 6. The Properties consist of two or more lots of record, each of which is contiguous for more than ten (1o) linear feet with the other lot on their respective common boundaries. Said lots are located within a single block and are hereby declared to be a tract of land to the treated as one zoning lot for the purposes of the Zoning Resolution. 7.This Declaration shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the StateofNewYork. 2 27655947v3
